executive_summary.text: Cost year 2025: laundry cost per resident day ($2.2) was 39% of the Connecticut median ($5.66). Ask how laundry is handled: by the home's own staff, by a contracted service, or with costs reported in another department.
Cost year 2025: direct care cost was $163.9 per resident day (39.4% of expenses); Connecticut median $174.45.
Cost year 2025: nursing home operating margin was 16.8% (Connecticut median 2.5%).
Cost year 2025: nursing pool (agency) staff counted in direct care cost $328,007, 4.6% of the $7,071,998 direct care cost.

Cost year 2025: dietary cost $1,185,087, $27.47 per resident day (Connecticut median $29.51). Wages $675,695 (57.0%), allocated fringe $105,334 (8.9%), non-wage costs $404,058 (34.1%). Raw food was $328,328 ($7.61 per resident day; Connecticut median $8.61) and purchased dietary services $4,697.
Cost year 2025: housekeeping cost $329,800, $7.64 per resident day (Connecticut median $12.32). Wages $257,657 (78.1%), allocated fringe $40,166 (12.2%), non-wage costs $31,977 (9.7%).
Missing data: cost year 2015 left out because the figures failed the site's checks (reasons under missing_data)

Every finding is labeled confirmed_fact, calculated, possible_association or investigative_question. Possible associations are not evidence of ownership, control or a conflict of interest.

missing_data.reason: Cost year 2015 is left out of this report: its figures failed the site's checks (direct care per resident day outside the plausible range; core figures (days, revenue or expenses) could not be read; payer days do not add up to the printed total). The filing is still listed in financials.json.

recommended_follow_up: Ask the home or DSS how laundry costs are reported on the cost report (in-house staff, purchased services or another department).

definitions.wages_reported: Salaries and wages printed on the cost report for that department. Not total department spending.
definitions.total_department_cost: Wages + allocated fringe + non-salary costs for the department, as computed by the site's cost-report build.
definitions.direct_care: DSS rate-setting definition: nursing and aide salaries, related fringe (allocated), and nursing pool (agency) cost.
definitions.figures: As filed by the home before DSS audit. Not Medicaid-allowable costs.
definitions.data_quality: Per year: status validated (core figures present, payer days add up, nothing out of range), unvalidated (read, but printed totals did not fully reconcile: treat as provisional) or check_failed (core figures missing or implausible: not used in reports). unusable_fields lists figures in that year that should not be quoted, with the reason.
definitions.raw_food_per_resident_day: Raw food cost / resident days. Only shown when the home buys its own food; when a contractor supplies meals the raw-food line is not comparable.
